neighbours.label: The modifier word that opens a multiword technical term in physics and nonlinear-dynamics prose (phase in 'phase transition', chaotic in 'chaotic map', inter- in 'intermetallic'), not the same word in its everyday sense.
fire: Near the critical point the magnet undergoes a second-order phase transition.

quiet: The second phase of the stadium renovation will start next spring.
